top.line: Why sovereign websites are where people start with RiskMandate: try, trust, then bring it to work.

in-short.line: Validated, but nothing to buy now; learnt by using; websites as the start; touch before deploy; B to C to B.

validated.line: The summit validated the technology, direction, need and price points, up to the £20,000 tier.

missing.line: Nobody said they would buy now: not for lack of value, but for lack of a place to start.

using.line: Vicky Wang ran a newsroom without code by delegating to agents kept under behaviour policies.

cells.line: AgentiCCells' cells can make websites; with the repository and address automated, a new product.

intersection.line: One-off, cheap, no lock-in, versioned, with provenance, edited by Claude or ChatGPT, made by cells.

touch.line: Nobody deploys agents they cannot see and stop; a site lets people try them and gain trust.

b2c2b.line: Everyone needs a site and a newsroom, so a corporate customer can first be a personal one.

limits.line: A hypothesis; summit interest was conversations; the handover has friction.

sources.line: My debrief on 21 November 2026, and the PrompTugal.news figures.
